Strategy: Add an exact-fit bonus on top of the very gentle ten sweet band and mid penalty, so perfectly filled bins always win. This tests whether even gentler steering plus exact fits improves further, but the smaller adjustments may rarely change any ranking.
```python
def priority(item, bins):
    return [1000.0 if r - item == 0 else (-(r - item) + (10 if r - item >= 30 and r - item <= 45 else 0) - (10 if r - item >= 8 and r - item <= 22 else 0)) for r in bins]
```
